highest_value_direct_analog.critical_limit: The published system is a proof-of-concept and does not externally validate JANUS self-drive or net-generation. Its reported membrane/module performance and auxiliary requirements must be treated as calibration evidence, not as a JANUS pass.

spider_deductions.D1: JANUS now has two distinct architecture modes that should be simulated separately rather than blended prematurely.

MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.flow: water -> O2-selective artificial-gill membrane -> low-pO2 recirculating gas -> PEM fuel cell -> moisture/heat exchanger -> return gas loop
MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.advantage: May bypass bulk O2/N2 separation and LOX in the first self-drive experiment, sharply reducing auxiliary burden.
MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.fuel_boundary: Hydrogen or another explicit fuel/reactant remains required; environmental O2 is oxidizer, not primary energy.

MODE_B_PROCESS_INTEGRATED_VRU_AKS.flow: water/dissolved-gas extraction -> conditioning -> O2/N2 separation -> O2 use/storage + N2 multi-duty cascade -> sorbent cycle -> optional cryogenic branch
MODE_B_PROCESS_INTEGRATED_VRU_AKS.advantage: Maximizes process integration and useful duties per stream, but has more parasitic loads and therefore should remain a later-stage architecture until Mode A transport is calibrated.

spider_deductions.D2: Boundary-layer transport is independently corroborated as a dominant artificial-gill variable. The large membrane crown should remain stationary by default while the 62.3 mm Axle drives water renewal/pumping/sweep only where measured benefit exceeds torque cost.
spider_deductions.D3: The previously frozen 423.5 m2 membrane figure must remain a screening point, not a design truth. Published systems span very different area/flux regimes because membrane permeance, module geometry, collector pO2, water-side transport and sweep/vacuum differ.
spider_deductions.D4: Digital-twin methods are unusually well aligned with JANUS: PSA cycle timing, membrane transport, hydrodynamic pressure drop and sorbent switching can all be calibrated independently before integrated hardware is attempted.

contradictions_and_cautions: No direct arXiv paper found in this pass that demonstrates an autonomous net-positive JANUS-like artificial-gill engine.
Artificial-gill literature demonstrates oxygen transfer, not free energy.
ASU/AKS nitrogen regeneration validates process reuse, not energetic self-sufficiency.
High membrane material permeance does not guarantee high module-level O2 flux because external water-side boundary layers and internal partial pressure can dominate.
Any vacuum, sweep, circulation, pump, compressor, valve, refrigeration and rotation power must remain explicit in R2A balances.
Oxygen-enriched and cryogenic service remain separate high-risk engineering stages and are not authorized by this research record.
